text: Not so fast, lad!
zh: 别急着走，小子！

text: You seem like a... smart fella to me. Am I right?
zh: 依我看，你像是个……聪明人。我说得对吧？

text: Who wants do know?
zh: 谁想知道这个？

text: What do you want?
zh: 你想干什么？

text: You're right!
zh: 你说得对！

text: I don't have time for such nonsense.
zh: 我没时间听这种废话。

text: Straight to the point, eh?
zh: 直奔主题，是吧？

text: You see... there are people with more good luck, and then there are people with more bad luck.
zh: 你瞧……这世上有些人运气好一些，有些人运气差一些。

text: In the past, I was one of the people with bad luck.
zh: 过去，我就是那种运气差的人。

text: Well then, no need to be so crass, yeah?
zh: 好了好了，用不着这么冲吧？

text: I knew it! Got an eye for such things, y'see!
zh: 我就知道！我看人的眼光可准了！

text: So... I decided to uh... work around my bad luck, yeah?
zh: 所以……我决定，呃……自己想办法绕开这倒霉运，懂吧？

text: No need to rely on things fallin' into your life if you can just... make them fall into your life, you know?
zh: 要是能让好东西自己“掉”进你的生活里，又何必干等着天上掉馅饼呢，你说是吧？

text: You're a thief?
zh: 你是个小偷？

text: I don't understand.
zh: 我没听懂。

text: You're crazy.
zh: 你疯了。

text: Thief's a bit of a... strong word.
zh: “小偷”这个词……有点重了。

text: You're absolutely right, though.
zh: 不过你说得一点没错。

text: Ah, I gotta be more precise, then.
zh: 啊，那我得说得更明白点。

text: You really need to work on your manners, lad. That was just rude.
zh: 你真该学学礼貌，小子。这话太无礼了。

text: If someone has a little too much of something, I make sure it gets shared.
zh: 要是有人某样东西多得用不完，我就负责让它被分享出去。

text: Mostly shared with me, that is.
zh: 主要是分享给我，就是了。

text: And here's where you come into play.
zh: 而这就轮到你登场了。

text:
I could show you a few of my thieving skills. I am especially good at picking locks.
For a small price, obviously.
zh:
我可以教你几手偷窃的本事。我尤其擅长开锁。
当然了，得收点小钱。

text:
Sounds promising, yeah?
You get somethin', I get somethin'.
zh:
听着不错吧？
你有好处，我也有好处。

text: Here you are!
zh: 你来啦！

text: What do you want for your skills?
zh: 你的本事要收多少钱？

text: Why do the people accept a thief?
zh: 为什么大家能容得下一个小偷？

text: Can you teach me something?
zh: 你能教我点什么吗？

text: Teach me!
zh: 教我吧！

text: Can you help me get past the guard?
zh: 你能帮我过守卫那关吗？

text: Do you know where Lennard's wares are?
zh: 你知道伦纳德的货在哪儿吗？

text: Where did you hide Lennard's wares?
zh: 你把伦纳德的货藏哪儿了？

text: Sell me Lennard's wares.
zh: 把伦纳德的货卖给我吧。

text: Do you have something to sell?
zh: 你有什么东西要卖吗？

text: Can you open a chest for me?
zh: 你能帮我开个箱子吗？

text: See you!
zh: 回头见！

text: Aye, catch you later.
zh: 好嘞，回头见。

text: Of course!
zh: 当然！

text: For you... only 100 gold.
zh: 看在你的面子上……只收100金币。

text: Here are your 100 gold.
zh: 这是你的100金币。

text: Maybe later.
zh: 以后再说吧。

text: Don't let this opportunity go to waste!
zh: 可别错过这个好机会！

text: There ya go! No way that you'll regret this!
zh: 这就对了！你绝对不会后悔的！

text: Let me know when you want to train some more.
zh: 想再练练的时候就跟我说。

text: What do you want to know?
zh: 你想知道些什么？

text: Show me how to pick locks. (min. 3 DEX) [2 AP]#args:{"hint":"ui_dialogue_hint_skill_lockpicking","only_once_on_difficulty": true}
zh: 教我怎么开锁。（需敏捷3）[2 技能点]#args:{"hint":"ui_dialogue_hint_skill_lockpicking","only_once_on_difficulty": true}

text: Nothing.
zh: 没什么。

text: The trick is to have the right equipment and the right skill.
zh: 诀窍在于要有合适的工具和到位的手艺。

text: Move forwards and backwards with the lockpick, until you hear a click sound.
zh: 用撬锁器前后拨动，直到听见“咔哒”一声。

text: After you got that, and with enough dexterity, you can safely open the chest.
zh: 掌握了这个，再加上足够的敏捷，你就能稳稳当当地打开箱子了。

text: Well, the answer is pretty simple. I am the only thief around.
zh: 呵，答案很简单。这一带就我一个小偷。

text: If something goes missing, guess who's going to be the suspect number one.
zh: 要是丢了什么东西，你猜头号嫌疑人会是谁。

text: Would be pretty stupid to steal from my own people.
zh: 偷自己人的东西，那可就太蠢了。

text: Though, it's two thieves now in the camp. Heh.
zh: 不过，现在营地里可有两个小偷了。嘿。

text:
We thieves better stick together, eh?
I'll take care of the guard.
zh:
我们小偷就该抱团，对吧？
守卫那边我来搞定。

text: That will cost you a bit, though.
zh: 不过，这得花你点钱。

text: 100 gold and I'll tell the guard to let you through.
zh: 100金币，我就去跟守卫打招呼放你过去。

text: Sounds fair, right?
zh: 挺公道的，对吧？

text: Are you for real?
zh: 你是认真的吗？

text: Here're your 100 gold.
zh: 这是你的100金币。

text: I'll have to think about it.
zh: 我得考虑考虑。

text: Alright. Just don't think too long.
zh: 行。可别考虑太久。

text: Sure I am!
zh: 当然是认真的！

text: That's a price between buddies, yeah?
zh: 这可是兄弟价，懂吧？

text: Pleasure doin' business, heh.
zh: 合作愉快，嘿。

text: Only the best for you, lad!
zh: 都是给你留的好货，小子！

text: Not only do I know where they are, I also know who has them.
zh: 我不但知道货在哪儿，还知道货在谁手上。

text: Me!
zh: 在我手上！

text: And no... I ain't giving them away.
zh: 不过嘛……我可不会白白交出来。

text: At least not for free.
zh: 至少不能免费。

text: How much do you offer?
zh: 你出多少？

text: No more than 100 gold.
zh: 最多100金币。

text: His wares are only worth 500 gold.
zh: 他的货最多值500金币。

text: 1000 gold are reasonable.
zh: 1000金币算合理了。

text: Lennard said, his wares are worth 1500 gold.
zh: 伦纳德说，他的货值1500金币。

text: You can have 2000 gold.
zh: 给你2000金币。

text: I need to think about that.
zh: 我得考虑一下。

text: Are you kidding me?
zh: 你在逗我吗？

text:
As a #:businessman:#, I know you're trying to rip me off.
Either you give me a good price or you forget about it.
zh:
作为一个#:生意人:#，我看得出你想坑我。
要么给个像样的价，要么就别谈了。

text: Hmm... I think his wares are worth more.
zh: 唔……我觉得他的货可不止这个价。

text:
Alright.
To compensate for the effort of "retrieving" his wares, I think 1700 gold are fair enough.
zh:
好吧。
考虑到我“取回”他这些货费的功夫，我觉得1700金币算公道了。

text:
Well...
I'll gladly take the 2000 gold.
zh:
这个嘛……
2000金币我就却之不恭了。

text: Almost...
zh: 就差一点……

text: Alright, take the 1700 gold.
zh: 好吧，1700金币拿去。

text: 1500... Take it or leave it.
zh: 1500……要就要，不要拉倒。

text: I don't know...
zh: 我说不好……

text: I see, you understand the art of trade, young fella.
zh: 看得出来，你懂做买卖的门道，年轻人。

text: Take your time.
zh: 慢慢考虑。

text: Lennard told me, that his wares are worth nothing.
zh: 伦纳德跟我说，他的货一文不值。

text: I would not know if you damaged or sold any of his wares.
zh: 我可没法知道你有没有弄坏或卖掉他的货。

text: How about 1000 gold?
zh: 1000金币怎么样？

text: Trust me, all is fine, and I did not damage any of his wares.
zh: 相信我，货都好好的，我一件都没弄坏。

text: Still, 500 gold is enough, given the risk.
zh: 就算这样，考虑到风险，500金币也够了。

text: Ok, take the 1000 gold.
zh: 行，1000金币拿去。

text:
How about 1000 gold.
That should be a good price.
zh:
1000金币怎么样？
这个价应该不错了。

text:
You know what?
I think I should keep the wares.
zh:
你猜怎么着？
我觉得这些货还是留在我这儿好了。

text: Sorry, here's the 1000 gold.
zh: 抱歉抱歉，这是1000金币。

text: Fine, let's forget about that.
zh: 行吧，那就当没这回事。

text: Ahh come on!
zh: 哎，别这样嘛！

text: Give me your damn 500 gold and you can have the wares.
zh: 把你那该死的500金币拿来，货就归你。

text:
Here, take them.
They were only consuming space anyway.
zh:
给，拿去吧。
反正它们也只是占地方。

text: Better late than never, right?
zh: 迟来总比不来强，对吧？

text: I need to think about that...
zh: 我得考虑一下……

text: Give my regards to Lennard, hehe!
zh: 替我向伦纳德问好，嘿嘿！

text: You can call me #:Jesse:#.
zh: 你可以叫我#:杰西:#。

text: It would not be good for the business, if I tell you that, right?
zh: 要是告诉你这个，那对生意可不好，对吧？

text: The goods are stored somewhere save outside the camp.
zh: 货存放在营地外一个安全的地方。

text: Alright.
zh: 好吧。

text: Tell me where the goods are, or I'll beat it out of you!
zh: 快说货在哪儿，不然我就打到你说为止！

text: You could, but I wouldn't tell you the location, though.
zh: 你可以试试，不过我照样不会说出地点。

text:
Not now.
Meet me later at the Crossroad Inn.
zh:
现在不行。
稍后到十字路旅店来找我。

text:
Basically, yes, but you cut me off earlier in the conversation.
And now I feel... offended, if you know what I mean.
zh:
基本上是的，不过你刚才打断了我说话。
现在我觉得……很受冒犯，你懂我的意思吧。

text: I think 50 gold pieces should lift my spirits again.
zh: 我看，50枚金币应该能让我心情重新好起来。

text: Alright. Here's 50 gold.
zh: 好吧。这是50金币。

text: Nevermind.
zh: 算了。

text: Whatever you say.
zh: 随你便。

text:
Thank you!
I'm feeling much better now, hehe.
zh:
多谢！
我现在感觉好多了，嘿嘿。

text: And now to your initial question.
zh: 现在回到你最初的问题。

text: So he doesn't want them back, then?
zh: 这么说，他不想要回这些货了？

text:
Hold on a second.
Someone's been messing with my chest.
zh:
等一下。
有人动过我的箱子。

text: And I've got a feeling that you know who it was.
zh: 而且我有种感觉，你知道是谁干的。
